digestRule: sha256 of lexicographically sorted path:sha256 lines, each newline-terminated

changeFromV1.reason: The immutable first sealed pack exposed a general semantic invariant: duration KPIs declared unit/outlier checks but omitted explicit grain validation.
changeFromV1.change: Duration KPI validation now requires unit, grain, and outlier checks.

assumption: The five candidate modules are frozen before any v2 case SQL, oracle, neutral identifier, filename, or digest is authored.
risk: The process is evaluator-separated but repository-local, so it is not organizationally independent validation.
fallback: A v2 hard/leakage/mutation/causality/budget failure leaves G4 uncredited; v1 and v2 remain immutable negative evidence.
reviewRollback: A later rerun is regression-only and cannot replace the single recorded v2 outcome.
